pathways.title: BC Provincial Nominee Program (SIRS)
pathways.eligibility_reason: a BC job offer is required to register in most BC PNP streams
pathways.note: a provincial nomination adds +600 CRS, the strongest single lever, but it is not something you can grant yourself

pathways.title: Saskatchewan Immigrant Nominee Program (SINP)
pathways.eligibility_reason: SINP Factor I score 62 of 80 (needs 60 total to submit an EOI); clears the floor on labour-market points alone
pathways.additional_requirements: Saskatchewan-connection points (family, past SK work/study, or a SK job offer) are not assessed here; invitations select by in-demand occupation through EOI draws
pathways.note: meeting the 60-point floor enters the EOI pool, it is not an invitation; SINP draws select on in-demand occupation and provincial need and can change at any time

pathways.title: Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program (OINP)
pathways.eligibility_reason: OINP is now the single Ontario Workforce Priority Stream (redesigned June 2026). You meet the TEER 0-3 skill floor (CLB 6 and post-secondary), but every pathway requires a full-time, permanent Ontario job offer (only self-employed physicians registered in Ontario are exempt), which is the binding requirement and is not something we can verify from your profile
pathways.additional_requirements: a full-time permanent Ontario job offer is required on every Workforce Priority pathway (self-employed physicians excepted)
pathways.note: a provincial nomination adds +600 CRS; OINP's former Express Entry pool streams were removed in the June 2026 redesign

pathways.title: Manitoba Provincial Nominee Program (MPNP)
pathways.eligibility_reason: MPNP self-assessment Factors 1-4 (language, age, work, education) = 65 of 75; you need 60 total AND a mandatory Manitoba connection (close relative, past MB work/study, or a recruitment invitation), which we do not assess
pathways.additional_requirements: a Manitoba connection is required of all applicants; without one you are ineligible regardless of points
pathways.note: a provincial nomination adds +600 CRS; Manitoba's 1000-point Expression-of-Interest ranking is a separate draw pool with no published pass mark

pathways.title: Alberta Advantage Immigration Program (AAIP)
pathways.eligibility_reason: Alberta nominates through the AAIP. Its worker streams (Tourism and Hospitality, Alberta Opportunity, Alberta Express Entry, and Rural Renewal) mostly require an Alberta job offer and employer requirements, and the Alberta Express Entry Stream selects candidates from the federal Express Entry pool through a Worker Expression of Interest. Selection is set by Alberta, so eligibility is not decided here
pathways.additional_requirements: most AAIP worker streams require an Alberta job offer and employer requirements; the Express Entry stream selects from the federal pool by Alberta's own criteria
pathways.note: a provincial nomination adds +600 CRS; AAIP publishes no candidate self-score grid, selection is by an Alberta job offer or the Alberta Express Entry Worker EOI

pathways.title: Nova Scotia Nominee Program (NSNP)
pathways.eligibility_reason: Nova Scotia nominates through the NSNP. Since February 2026 it runs consolidated streams (Skilled Worker, Nova Scotia Graduate, Entrepreneur, and Nova Scotia: Express Entry): you submit an Expression of Interest to a stream and Nova Scotia selects from the pool in periodic, priority-based draws. Selection is discretionary (labour-market need, occupation and sector priorities, retention), not a candidate score, so eligibility is not decided here
pathways.additional_requirements: selection is by discretionary EOI draws on provincial priorities, and for the Express Entry stream by a Notice of Interest in the federal pool; entering the pool does not guarantee selection
pathways.note: a provincial nomination adds +600 CRS; NSNP publishes no candidate self-score grid, selection is by priority-based EOI draws

pathways.title: New Brunswick Provincial Nominee Program (NBPNP)
pathways.eligibility_reason: New Brunswick nominates through the New Brunswick Provincial Nominee Program (NBPNP). Its streams set their own criteria, so eligibility is checked on the province's site, not decided here
pathways.additional_requirements: each stream has its own eligibility rules and intake
pathways.note: a nomination through an enhanced (Express Entry-aligned) stream adds +600 CRS, effectively guaranteeing an invitation
